title: Det-MASO: Diversity-Regularized Multi-Agent Sequential Optimization for Factor Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantitative investment requires alpha factors that are both predictive and diverse. However, existing factor generation methods, including formulaic mining and neural end-to-end models, are mostly based on a single-agent design, which limits exploration of the factor space and reduces adaptability to changing markets. Multi-agent approaches can broaden exploration, but agents trained under a shared objective often collapse to similar outputs, while existing diversity techniques either scale poorly with asset-universe size or address redundancy only after training. We propose a multi-agent sequential optimization (Det-MASO) framework for generating diversified, context-adaptive alpha factors. It introduces a differentiable log-determinant penalty on the inter-agent correlation matrix directly into the joint objective, discouraging correlated agent behavior during training with computational cost that scales linearly with the number of as

translated_title: Det-MASO：面向因子生成的多样性正则化多智能体序列优化
translated_abstract: 量化投资需要兼具预测性和多样性的Alpha因子。然而，现有的因子生成方法，包括公式化挖掘和神经端到端模型，大多基于单智能体设计，这限制了对因子空间的探索，并降低了对变化市场的适应能力。多智能体方法可以拓宽探索范围，但在共享目标下训练的智能体往往坍缩为相似输出，而现有的多样性技术要么随资产池规模扩展性不佳，要么只能在训练之后处理冗余问题。我们提出了一种多智能体序列优化框架，用于生成多样化、上下文自适应的Alpha因子。该方法在联合目标中直接引入对智能体间相关性矩阵的可微分对数行列式惩罚，在训练过程中抑制智能体间的相关行为，且计算成本随智能体数量线性增长。
tldr: 该论文提出Det-MASO框架，通过在联合优化目标中引入对智能体间相关性矩阵的可微分对数行列式惩罚，在训练阶段直接促进多智能体生成多样化且适应市场变化的Alpha因子。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Det-MASO, a multi-agent sequential optimization framework that integrates a differentiable log-determinant penalty on inter-agent correlation matrices into the joint objective, directly encouraging diverse and market-adaptive alpha factor generation during training.
